Resources for a considered conversion

Bring building information, operating assumptions and maintenance questions into the same discussion.

Before a site discussion

List fixture quantities, facility type, location, opening hours and known drainage issues. Confirm who can review plumbing and mounting conditions.

Before a budget decision

Find your marginal combined water and wastewater rate, existing flush volume and actual operating days. Separate fixed utility charges from charges that change with water use.

Before handover

Request current manufacturer documentation, a compatible cleaning routine, consumables references and a clear responsibility for maintenance records.
